channel.title: The Grant Desk - Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, UK, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• ITER 2026: International Touring and Environmental Responsibility Programme
    https://juliesbicycle.org/news/iter-2026/
    Julie's Bicycle and in futurum, funded by Arts Council England, Arts Council Norway, Creative Scotland and the Danish Arts Foundation · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · The seminar programme is free to join. Groups of three or more participants can then apply for up to GBP 30,000 for collaborative projects, with funding applications open 6 November 2026 to 11 January 2027 and projects starting spring 2027. No application fee.
  • Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    https://waag.org/en/article/open-call-creative-interventions-trust-me-im-airtist/
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• University of East Anglia: Deputy Dean, CUCN-UEA Digital Creativity Institute
    https://vacancies.uea.ac.uk/vacancies/vacancy-search-results.aspx
    University of East Anglia (UEA), Faculty of Arts and Humanities · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · GBP 69,488 to 73,709 per annum depending on qualifications and experience, plus the standard UEA pension and leave package. No application fee.
  • UAL AKO Storytelling Institute: Storytelling Research Fellows 2026 (six posts)
    https://jobs.arts.ac.uk/job/12629-storytelling-research-fellows/
    University of the Arts London (UAL AKO Storytelling Institute), with the Power of Pop Fund · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · GBP 48,563 per annum pro rata (around GBP 19,425 for the part-time fellowship hours), plus UAL benefits. No application fee.

item.title: 5 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
• SIAP: Major Individual Artists Award 2026/27 (Arts Council NI)
    https://artscouncil-ni.org/funding-for-individuals/major-individual-artists
    Arts Council of Northern Ireland · deadline Closed 20 Jul 2026 · Up to GBP 15,000 per award; four awards available in 2026/27. Funded through the National Lottery Support for Individual Artists Programme (SIAP).
  • Creative Steps for Individuals 2026 (Arts Council of Wales)
    http://arts.wales/funding/individuals/creative-steps-for-individuals
    Arts Council of Wales · deadline Closed 29 Jul 2026 · GBP 500 to GBP 7,500 (plus access costs). Applicants can apply for up to 90% of the developmental cost; the remaining 10% must come from a non-Arts Council of Wales / non-National Lottery source (in-kind, cash, or both).
  • SIAP: Project Funding for Individual Artists 2026 (Arts Council NI)
    https://artscouncil-ni.org/funding-for-individuals/project-funding-for-individuals
    Arts Council of Northern Ireland · deadline Closed 30 Jul 2026 · GBP 62 to GBP 15,000. Funded through the National Lottery Support for Individual Artists Programme (SIAP).
  • SIAP: Artists' International Development Fund 2026 (Arts Council NI)
    https://artscouncil-ni.org/funding-for-individuals/artists-international-development-fund-individuals
    Arts Council of Northern Ireland · deadline Closed 30 Jul 2026 · GBP 62 to GBP 15,000. Funded through the National Lottery Support for Individual Artists Programme (SIAP).
  • Creative Scotland Open Fund for Individuals
    https://www.creativescotland.com/funding/funding-programmes/open-funding/open-fund-for-individuals
    Creative Scotland · deadline Rolling / undated · Between GBP 500 and GBP 50,000. Overall annual budget for the fund is GBP 5 million.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
